track: D: scripted protocol provider; no model task-quality or billing claim

products.OpenClaw: 2026.10.8 Gateway, authenticated nonstreaming OpenAI HTTP endpoint

unit: one fresh native server/state/workspace with primary plus independent companion sessions; one synthetic ACK task each
pairing: same marker format and response action, independently random markers per session; products interleaved per condition; reverse product order on even formal blocks
client: external Python HTTP result consumer, outside product cgroup; DSH accepted prompt then session.wait; OpenClaw nonstreaming POST chat/completions. Abrupt SIGKILL closes transport, not a native CLI abort/UI-disconnect claim
boundary: independent provider ledger records both actual task requests before blocking; both clients confirm result-request bytes sent; all gates release only after condition intervention
owner: unique native root in owned cgroup; UID, command, PPID and /proc start ticks recorded and rechecked; SIGKILL only this PID, never whole cgroup as intervention
observation: process/client witnesses at release, 0.5, 2 and 10 seconds; do not kill remaining product descendants until this window ends
recovery: after window read native history if carrier survives; finish old cgroup (cleanup), restart same product state/workspace, passive native history immediately and after 10-second window, then one explicit NEW prompt per existing session without session.create; never replay original input in adapter
history: DSH session.events + session.state; OpenClaw native gateway call chat.history. Reads remain separate from independent provider truth; report any read-triggered native recovery as observation-path recovery, not unconditional boot recovery
terminal: client terminal fields, exact native assistant ACK and retained user record assessed independently; HTTP error/timeout never alone proves task failure. Native negative/uncertain fault outcomes stay valid

safeguards.meaning: predeclared preparation/operation failure detection, not a generic real-task wall quota

resource_scope: two 2-CPU/3-GiB native service cgroup cycles per arm; server descendants included. Controller, synthetic provider, HTTP clients and history CLI outside; CLI CPU separately retained, PSS not attributed to server. Cleanup distinct from owner intervention
admission: one complete pilot block per product, 6 arms total, all controls and passive history adapters usable. Publish measured full-block duration plus setup/cleanup uncertainty before a separately dispatched two-block formal run
native_observability: freeze native-only packets, identifiers and question set; isolated automated investigator sees no condition labels/PID maps/provider ledger/controller truth; freeze answer before scoring against independent truth, retain unknown/incorrect/correct. Current informed controller cannot claim blind reconstruction
